LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Verified personal-best step count submitted by a solver for a specific puzzle.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the solver.

displayName.description: Public workshop handle shown on the leaderboard (no PII).

puzzleId.description: Puzzle identifier in the range 1 to 1000.

steps.description: Verified instruction count used to solve the puzzle.

parSteps.description: Reference par step count for the puzzle.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the entry was first recorded.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the entry was last improved.

/leaderboardEntries/{entryId}.description: Public per-puzzle leaderboard scores keyed deterministically as {puzzleId}_{uid}.
